source_scope: Four owner-uploaded JPEGs, separate from the prior eight AT-343 originals.
approved_use: Architecture-first source registration and context; no pickup identity, permanent coordinate, or geographic boundary changed.
source_retention: Original files remain unchanged in project sources. GitHub copies retain every primary image pixel and full original framing and colour profile. Camera metadata and embedded non-frame payloads are omitted. The existing close-ups remain unchanged. Any future crop or alignment must use copies.
orientation: Source in-game map is fixed north-up. Camera perspective, scale, display overlays and partial extents can vary.
x_mark_policy: Faint crosses are secondary local alignment candidates after nearby architectural matches; they are not pickup markers or exact coordinates.

visual_catalogue.title: Bleu Plaza and north/west overlap
visual_catalogue.visible_content: Bleu Sectors 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10 have visible labels; Wild Zone 5 across Bleu 1–2, Estival Avenue, Café Rouleau, Shutterbug Café, Café Soleil and Café Woof. Bleu 4 is shown with adjoining buildings and routes, while the preserved tight crop is clearer for its label. Several outer blocks are clipped.

visual_catalogue.title: Bleu Plaza and south/west overlap
visual_catalogue.visible_content: Bleu Sectors 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 have visible labels, plus South Boulevard, Bleu Plaza, Café Soleil, Aymlis Park and the Pokémon Center. Bleu 8 and its circular courtyard have wider context than the existing tight crop; the tight crop remains clearer for its label. The source edges cut neighboring areas.

visual_catalogue.title: Prism Tower, centre-north
visual_catalogue.visible_content: Centres on the tower’s northern approaches: Rouge Street, Hibernal and Autumnal Avenues, Rouge 1, Magenta 2, Jaune 2 and Jaune 3, Restaurant Le Wow and the Saison Canal. The label in Jaune 1 is partly covered; the southwest sector number is obscured.

visual_catalogue.title: Prism Tower, centre-south
visual_catalogue.visible_content: Overlapping tower footprint with the southern approaches: Bleu Sectors 1 and 2, Wild Zone 5, Vert 1 and 2, the edge of Vert Plaza, Nouveau Café, Café Gallant, Saison Canal and Jaune 2. The adjacent Magenta label is partly covered.
